name: Presentation Template by Blush
label: Blush
measuredFrom: 22 exported frames at 1920×1080, palette sampled per frame with PIL, geometry scaled ×2/3
motif: flat pastel walls over a saturated floor band, bold geometric titles, pink blob counters on a sky-blue line, half-and-half colour splits, playful flat shapes standing on the floor
rhythm: cream|teal, white|cream, cream|coral, cyan, cobalt half, white|mauve, aqua half, blush|blue, pink|salmon, cream|sea, pool|salmon, white + wave field, cream|teal (chart), blush|blue, sky|blue, white|cream half, white|cream, image|teal, cream|teal (custom), cream|salmon

type.family: geometric sans: bold titles, regular subtitles, medium body

fonts.source: Gotham (Bold titles, Book/Medium body), identified visually; Montserrat is the closest Google family

geometry.floor: a full-width band 90–140px tall at the slide foot, in a stronger colour than the wall
